findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pay_service, quote_service, route_by_intent, setup_delegation, get_budget · Private data: get_service, pay_service, quote_service, route_by_intent, setup_delegation, get_budget, get_payment_result, list_payments, payment_summary, wallet_balance · Public sink: pay_service · Destructive: get_service, pay_service, setup_delegation, get_budget.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pay_service, quote_service, route_by_intent, setup_delegation, get_budget · Private data: get_service, pay_service, quote_service, route_by_intent, setup_delegation, get_budget, get_payment_result, list_payments, payment_summary, wallet_balance · Public sink: pay_service · Destructive: get_service, pay_service, setup_delegation, get_budget

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
